t: IOC forms World Anti-Doping Agency
c: In 1999, the IOC formed the World Anti-Doping Agency (WADA) in an effort to systematise the research and detection of performance-enhancing drugs.

t: First women compete for Afghanistan
c: In 2004, Robina Muqimyar and Fariba Rezayee became the first women to compete for Afghanistan.

t: United Arab Emirates sends female athletes to Olympics
c: In 2008, the United Arab Emirates sent female athletes for the first time; Maitha Al Maktoum competed in taekwondo, and Latifa Al Maktoum in equestrian.

t: Curling introduces mixed doubles event
c: Beginning in 2018, the sport of curling introduced a mixed event where teams of one man and one woman competed in their own tournament for a medal.

t: Gold medal composition changes to gilded silver
c: The winners receive gold medals, which were solid gold until 1912, later made of gilded silver, and now gold-plated silver.
